name: Sphinx Will

acquire.equipPiece: A single gold nemes brow-band carrying the eye-glyph on the forehead (the only equipped piece).

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form: the whole body becomes a winged lion-humanoid in sandstone-and-lapis armor: calm human-like face under a striped nemes headdress, wide feathered wings with winged pauldrons, broad lion shoulders, clawed paws, digitigrade lion legs and a tufted tail; an eye-glyph glaive forms in the hand.

equip.weapon: A lion-claw glaive whose blade is a gold eye-glyph, formed from sandstone and lapis.
equip.armor: Sandstone plated back, lapis breastplate, winged pauldrons and a striped nemes headdress.
equip.hair_eyes: Black hair under the striped nemes, calm glowing gold eyes.
equip.aura: Gold sand motes with blue glyph light.

beastNote: The Sphinx of the Riddle (winged lion body, human head)
lore: A winged stone-lion with a calm human face that asks one question and keeps the silence for those who cannot answer.
pitch: The Sphinx is the winged stone lion with a human face that asks a riddle and punishes those who fail. Acquire keeps you human, stepping in precise blue afterimages with one gold brow-band. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a winged lion-humanoid in sandstone and lapis armor with a glyph glaive, a heavy tank with two crowd-control moves, paid for with a high strain.
untrained: An untrained holder is asked the riddle by their own will: strain climbs and they freeze in place as stone while it waits for an answer. The will lay dormant until forcibly awakened; if the holder cannot balance it the clash tears at body and core and can kill, and only training the holder's own core and the beast core (best teacher: the beast itself) tames it.

spirit.echo: A rising lion-man in sandstone-and-lapis armor on digitigrade legs: calm human face under a striped nemes headdress, wide feathered wings, broad lion shoulders, clawed paws, tufted tail, an eye-glyph glaive.
spirit.look: A lapis-blue orb carved with a gold eye-glyph in the centre, sandstone flecks drifting off it, a calm closed eyelid that opens when held.
